title: StarterDeck: compact onboarding tiles for Optimize toolkit (quantization + caching)
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Create a compact, copy-first StarterDeck of onboarding tiles and supporting screenshot assets for the Optimize toolkit. Focus is on two recommendation flows: batching + caching presets and quantization profiles. The Deck should fit inside the Console first-run panel and docs quickstart, with 3 responsive size variants (card, list item, micro-tile). Deliver hi-fi artboards, annotated specs, and export-ready PNG/SVGs for product and docs teams.
acceptance_criteria: Three primary tile variants created: Card (desktop), List (responsive), Micro-tile (compact sidebar)
Each tile contains: short title (max 40 chars), one-line benefit, recommended preset chips, one small visual (sparkline or icon), and microcopy for tradeoffs (cost/latency/quality)
Quantization UI mock: slider + preset chips (FP16, Q4_0, Q4_1, Q8_0) with inline quality delta and estimated cost savings shown as percentages
Caching UI mock: toggle + TTL presets (None, Short, Medium, Long) with suggested use-cases and expected token-savings estimate
Batching recommendations: 3 presets with tooltip content describing latency vs throughput tradeoff and an example throughput chart
All assets exported to Drive and Figma with naming conventions and annotated spec sheet (spacing, type, color tokens)
Design handoff notes and a single PRD link posted to Confluence with acceptance test steps for ENG
Accessibility: color contrast passes WCAG AA for all text; interactive elements reachable by keyboard
design_notes: Tone: concise, action-oriented (verbs first). Use plain numbers for savings (e.g., -23% cost)
Visual language: small sparkline + single-icon motif to keep tiles dense; use 'meter' micro-visual for quantization quality delta
Recommendation presets: Low-latency (batch=1-2, cache=off), Balanced (batch=4-8, cache=short), High-throughput (batch=16+, cache=medium/long)
Default selected state should be 'Balanced' for new users; show 'why this matters' tooltip anchored to preset chips
Quantization slider shows simulated quality delta from baseline (float) and cost savings range; values are illustrative and annotated as estimates
Microcopy constraints: title <= 40 chars, subtitle <= 90 chars, tooltip <= 240 chars
Export formats: 2x PNG for docs hero, SVG icon set, Figma components with variants for states (default/hover/selected/disabled)
deliverables: 6 hi-fi artboards (desktop card x2 variants, list, micro-tile, quantization full modal, caching full modal)
Annotated spec sheet (spacing, tokens, copy rules)
Exported PNGs and SVGs placed in Drive folder
Figma component library updates with variants and tokens
Design handoff note + acceptance checklist in Confluence
